rows.description: a sharp violet white arcane dart with a compact bright core and curling purple plasma tail; the tail twists and pulses across the four frames
one literal long blue crystalline ice shard pointed forward, white faceted spear tip, small frost crystals shedding from the back as facets shimmer
a small golden musical note carried on three compact amber sound-wave streaks, note bobbing and waves pulsing as it travels forward
a small bright teal white life-energy spark with a pointed traveling core, two teal wisps spiraling behind it, pulsing brighter then dimmer
a narrow jagged electric blue and white lightning bolt traveling forward, branching arcs flickering backward and sparks shifting along the bolt
a tiny pointed ivory golden light bolt with a bright core and short streaming holy sparks; the core flares and the trail changes
